meta.name: Setup F Candidate — Prior Day High/Low Test
meta.reason_not_live: OOS n=48 < 50 minimum gate. Need ~6 more months of live data.
meta.oos_gate_result: FAIL — n=48 (needs 50). Sharpe=8.27 and EV=+0.622R both PASS individually.
meta.notes: Highest OOS Sharpe of all patterns tested (8.27). Narrowly missed n gate by 2 trades. Very high conviction candidate for Setup F once sample size clears 50 OOS trades.

specification.htf_bias_method: 4hour EMA20 — close > ema*1.001 = bullish, < ema*0.999 = bearish

entry_conditions.long: Current bar low touches within 0.2 ATR of prior trading day low AND bar closes bullish AND 4h bias is bullish
entry_conditions.short: Current bar high touches within 0.2 ATR of prior trading day high AND bar closes bearish AND 4h bias is bearish

specification.prior_day_calculation: Prior calendar trading day (Mon uses Friday's levels). High and low of all 5min bars in the prior day's session.

comparison.verdict: PDH/L has superior Sharpe but insufficient sample. Re-evaluate when OOS n >= 50.

revisit_checklist: Run backtest_ema50_pullback.py equivalent for PDH/L to get updated OOS n
Re-run IS/OOS split with updated data
If Sharpe >= 4.0 AND EV > 0 AND n >= 50: promote to Setup F and implement
Check for regime changes — if WR has decayed significantly, revisit entry conditions
